text: sorry let me ask you a question, did you disable the paint layer or something? because i would still like to have that if that was removed. if not, then im just getting weird results with the prop i just painted but il try compile again
resolution: Diagnostic question: did recent work disable paint? Answer: NO. Verified (1) texture slots store membership in face.material and NOTHING in the paint/atlas/textureize pipeline reads face.material, so authoring slots cannot affect painting; (2) the only paint-controller change (req_1538 mirror hook) leaves the primary brush stamp byte-identical and only mirrors when a plane is toggled. Paint mode is fully intact. The user then clarified the ACTUAL problem: a painted cooked prop shows its paint in the editor (req_1496 inline mesh texture) but renders GRAY in the compiled game — i.e. the texture doesn't survive Compile into the no-V8 loader. That is tracked as req_1544.
